garden.title: Garden of Ceramic Worlds
garden.what: The central sculpture garden, where ceramic landmarks, tiled courts and pools open onto an outdoor archive of scanned places to the south.

madmaraca-court.title: Madmaraca Court
madmaraca-court.what: The western court around Madmaraca, the tall ceramic library sculpture.

minarete-court.title: Minarete Court
minarete-court.what: The eastern court around Minarete Temple and its ground-level arch.

beacon-court.title: Beacon Court
beacon-court.what: The northern court around the Celadon Beacon, above the central garden on the map.

eden-garden.title: Verdelis Eden Garden
eden-garden.what: A planted garden among the ceramic landmarks, named for Verdelis and the Eden Garden.

grotto-court.title: Grotto Court
grotto-court.what: The approach court for the Grotto of Painted Worlds and its pools.

madmaraca.title: Madmaraca Ceramic Library
madmaraca.what: Vanessa Rosa’s ceramic library sculpture stands west of the central garden. Its sculpted exterior is the attraction; the interior is closed.

minarete.title: Minarete Temple
minarete.what: A tall ceramic temple on the eastern court. A narrow north–south arch passes through its base; the upper interior is closed.

celadon-beacon.title: Celadon Beacon
celadon-beacon.what: A green ceramic tower north of the garden. Its ground arch forms a north–south passage beneath the closed upper tower.

minarete-passage.title: Minarete Ground Passage
minarete-passage.what: The ground-level route through the arch at the base of Minarete Temple.

celadon-passage.title: Celadon Ground Passage
celadon-passage.what: The ground-level route through the arch beneath the Celadon Beacon.

auxiliary-tower.title: Garden Ceramic Tower
auxiliary-tower.what: A smaller stepped ceramic tower south of Madmaraca, with a ground hall and three upper rooms connected by floating shafts.

auxiliary-temple.title: Garden Minaret Temple
auxiliary-temple.what: A smaller blue temple south of Minarete, with a ground pavilion and two upper halls connected by floating shafts.

painted-grotto.title: Grotto of Painted Worlds
painted-grotto.what: A basalt vault with a broad northern doorway, hanging pale strands and red blossoms. The gentle approach leads down into the grotto beside two pools.

grotto-approach.title: Grotto Approach
grotto-approach.what: A gentle descent from the northern doorway to the lower grotto floor.

grotto-causeway.title: Grotto Causeway
grotto-causeway.what: The ground between the grotto pools, connecting their edges within the painted grotto.

grotto-pool-1.title: First Grotto Pool
grotto-pool-1.what: One of the two pools beside the causeway in the Grotto of Painted Worlds.

grotto-pool-2.title: Second Grotto Pool
grotto-pool-2.what: The companion pool across the causeway from the first grotto pool.

tharsis-plateau.title: Tharsis Plateau
tharsis-plateau.what: A raised plateau beyond the ceramic garden, reached by the Tharsis ramp.

tharsis-overlook.title: Tharsis Overlook
tharsis-overlook.what: An open viewpoint on the Tharsis Plateau, away from the courts and pools of the garden.

tharsis-ramp.title: Tharsis Ramp
tharsis-ramp.what: The footpath leading up to the plateau and its overlook.

glazed-basin-north-west.title: Northwest Glazed Basin
glazed-basin-north-west.what: The northwest water basin in the central ceramic garden.

glazed-basin-north-east.title: Northeast Glazed Basin
glazed-basin-north-east.what: The northeast water basin in the central ceramic garden.

glazed-basin-south-west.title: Southwest Glazed Basin
glazed-basin-south-west.what: The southwest water basin in the central ceramic garden.

glazed-basin-south-east.title: Southeast Glazed Basin
glazed-basin-south-east.what: The southeast water basin in the central ceramic garden.

worldAbout.title: Little Martians Ceramic Worlds
worldAbout.what: A sculpture garden of ceramic libraries, temples and towers, with grotto pools, a plateau overlook and an outdoor archive of scanned places.
worldAbout.tour: Madmaraca stands on the west court, Minarete on the east court, and the Celadon Beacon to the north. Smaller roomed towers sit south of the main sculptures. Follow the grotto approach down to the Painted Worlds vault and pools. The Tharsis ramp leads to the plateau overlook. Farther south, rows of named scan exhibits form an open-air archive; their scanned interiors are viewed from outside.
